assets.scope: Standee batch 2 (18 ids). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it is width-bound and renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.

references.note: The shipped flat ogre-mauler token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours, outfit and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native ogre-mauler sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The shipped ogre-guard token shares this ogre body plan, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose, its shield or its hammer.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: ogre mauler: a huge brutish male ogre with brick-red skin, a heavy bare muscular chest, thick arms and short thick legs, a low brow and small tusks, wearing only a dark brown loincloth and a heavy studded leather strap; both hands grip the long shaft of a massive iron-banded stone maul. Match the shipped flat token's brick-red skin, bare chest and brown loincloth.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height and hold the maul across the body with the heavy head low beside one boot, or resting on the shoulder with the head beside the skull; keep the shaft close so it does not stick out sideways. It differs from the rune-spinner (a female ogre with rune-tattooed skin, a skirt and a hovering spell flame) and from the ogric abomination (grey skin, one purple golem-arm graft, a crude club).
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, both hands on the maul shaft held close, feet planted, the bare head at the top of the frame. Overall height about 1.5 to 1.7 times the width; keep any maul head at or below the top of the skull.
prompt_fields.palette: brick-red skin, dark brown loincloth and leather, dull iron maul head on a dark wooden haft, small ivory tusks, dark hair.

prompt_fields.subject: ogre rune-spinner: a tall FEMALE ogre rune-caster with warm orange-red skin completely covered in glowing amber arcane runes and sigils, a strong but clearly female build, dark hair tied back, a short red-brown wrapped skirt and shoulder wrap; one arm is raised with the palm open and a swirling ball of orange rune-fire hovering just above the hand, the other arm hangs at her side. Match the shipped flat token's orange-red rune-tattooed skin, fire-on-hand and dark hair.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand upright with the raised arm close to the head and the hovering flame directly above the open palm, and a body narrower and more slanted than the bulky male mauler. The orange rune-flame above the hand is NOT part of the body. She differs from the ogre mauler (a bare-chested male with an iron maul) by the rune-covered skin, the skirt and the spell flame.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, one arm raised with an open palm and a floating rune-flame above it, the other arm down, feet planted, the head at the top of the body. Overall height about 1.6 to 1.8 times the width; the flame above the hand is the only thing above the head.
prompt_fields.palette: warm orange-red skin with bright amber glowing runes, dark brown hair, red-brown cloth wrap, orange rune-fire.

prompt_fields.subject: ogric abomination: a grey-lavender ogre that has grafted golem parts onto itself, one whole arm and shoulder replaced by a bulky purple-blue crystal-and-iron golem limb, the other a normal ogre arm ending in a fist that grips a crude iron-headed club; patchy stitched skin, an iron plate bolted over one eye, a metal seam running down the chest and a heavy graft joint at the hip. Match the shipped flat token's grey-lavender flesh, purple golem graft and crude club.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide but visibly asymmetric: the bulky golem arm hangs close on one side and the club arm stays near the torso, so the graft reads without widening the figure. It differs from the ogre mauler (uniform red skin, two normal arms) and the rune-spinner (female, rune tattoos, spell flame).
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, the grafted golem arm on one side, the club held low and close on the other, feet planted, the patchwork head at the top of the frame. Overall height about 1.5 to 1.7 times the width; keep the club head at or below the top of the skull.
prompt_fields.palette: grey-lavender ogre skin with stitch marks, purple and steel-blue crystal golem graft, dark iron plates and club head, dull bone.
